responsibility: This makefile fragment defines how the GNU Fortran front end is built, linked, documented, installed, and cleaned within the top-level GCC build. It partitions gfortran sources into parser/front-end objects versus translation-to-GENERIC objects, supplies the rules for producing the f951 compiler proper and the gfortran driver, wires in language-specific flags and generated-type dependencies, and adds targets for manuals, info/pdf/html output, tests, installation names, and stage movement of Fortran object files during bootstrap.
